name: @nodeve/schema
description: Hardware catalog schema as a relational model, authored in LinkML. One source projects to SQL DDL, JSON Schema, TS types, and Pydantic.

scripts.generate: node project-overlay.ts && node format.ts && node bundle.ts
scripts.build: pnpm generate && pnpm build:ddl && pnpm build:db
scripts.build:ddl: cd linkml && uvx --from linkml gen-sqltables nodeve.yaml > ../gen/nodeve.sql
scripts.build:db: cd linkml && uvx --from linkml linkml-sqldb dump -s nodeve.yaml -C Catalog -D ../gen/catalog.db ../gen/catalog.yaml
scripts.validate: cd linkml && uvx --from linkml linkml-validate -s ../gen/nodeve-projected.yaml -C Inverter ../data/device_model/foxess-h3-ps10sh.yaml
